div.head: Hn 87.6a
div.ab: Quia, sicut prediximus, multis modis potest homo weram suam forisfacere, ut per hamsocnam, per homicidium in ecclesia, per Dei rectum difforciatum, per furtum, per murdrum, per iniustum assultum uel homicidium et deinceps similium, de quibus wera parentibus, manbota domino et wita iusticiis remanet.

div.ab: For, as we have said before, a man can forfeit his wergild in many ways, as by hamsocna (attack on a house), by homicide in a church, by God's right withheld by force, by theft, by murdrum (secret killing), by unjust assault or homicide and so on with similar things, in which the wergild remains to the kinsmen, the manbot to the lord, and the wite to the justices.
